description: Remove the per-request `proxy` field from all JSON request bodies and the code that only consumed it. The global PROXY_URL (cfg.ProxyURL) must still apply everywhere. The `proxy` query param on search endpoints is NOT a request body field and stays as is (user asked only for request bodies).
steps: internal/model/request.go: delete the `Proxy` field from all 7 request structs.

internal/service/downloader.go: remove req.Proxy / opts.Proxy usage (lines ~74-78, 85, 92, 376, 393, 641, 665-669, 700). Use d.cfg.ProxyURL directly for ResolveShortURL; call threads.GetInfo and runner.GetInfo without a proxy override. Keep the Search proxy param fed by the query string.

internal/ytdlp/args.go: remove DownloadOptions.Proxy, and the proxyOverride param of BuildInfoArgs/baseArgs (keep BuildSearchArgs override since search query param remains); baseArgs uses cfg.ProxyURL. Update internal/ytdlp/runner.go Runner.GetInfo signature and implementation.
internal/gallerydl/runner.go: remove Options.Proxy, use cfg.ProxyURL only. internal/threads/runner.go: remove Options.Proxy and GetInfo proxyOverride; clientForProxy uses cfg.ProxyURL only.

Update tests/mocks: internal/service/downloader_test.go (mockRunner.GetInfo, mockThreadsRunner.GetInfo, infoFn), internal/ytdlp/runner_test.go (drop the 'audio extraction with proxy override' case or convert to assert env proxy applies), gallerydl/threads tests if affected.

Docs: API.md remove `proxy` rows/field mentions in info (line 64), download (81), youtube video/audio and tiktok (146-149); keep the search query param mention at line 132. README.md line 87: say proxy is set globally via PROXY_URL only.
Run `make swag` to regenerate docs/, then go vet and tests.
acceptance_criteria: No `proxy` JSON field remains in internal/model/request.go or docs/swagger.json request definitions
Setting PROXY_URL still adds --proxy to yt-dlp/gallery-dl args and threads client (existing env-proxy tests pass)
docs/ regenerated and consistent with code
API.md and README.md no longer mention a body-level proxy
findings: Changes are staged but NOT committed: git commit failed because gpg signing is unavailable in the sandbox.
